descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使吃过点心后补画的旋圈，末端留着一口的空白。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s pastry sketch leaves a bite-sized gap at the end of the coil.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自绘的午饭盘，肉汁已经越过了他画的分隔线。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s lunch sketch lets gravy cross the divisions on the plate.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使做的纸包可以翻到旁边，露出背后的空白窗。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s paper mailbag folds aside to reveal an open viewing window.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使折的纸条上，长短两行脚印轮流走在前面。
descriptions.en: On the messenger’s folded strip, long and short paper footprints take turns leading.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自折的两片纸卷一大一小，合起来刚好成为一只圆面包。
descriptions.en: Two unequal paper pieces folded by the messenger close into one round bun.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使做的立体纸卡，一展开，两只纸鞋同时落稳。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s original pop-up card settles two paper shoes side by side.
